query.text: الرياض أمانة منطقة الرياض خريطة الأراضي قطع الأراضي GIS بيانات مفتوحة

assessment: Official Riyadh geospatial and open-data portals surfaced. The spatial portal describes GIS layers and export/import of shapefiles and mentions land plots, but no anonymous downloadable cadastral parcel layer or API was verified in this search.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
